THE JOURNEY · From the Vault

THE DIVIDE

The Great Divide Mountain Bike Route · Whitefish, Montana → Santa Fe, New Mexico · Jun 24 → Aug 30, 2023 · 68 days · Five states

THE DIVIDE — the film, 11 minutes, from the 2023 vault

“I saw a grizzly, fairly close today. I almost hit him with my bike.”

Summer 2023. The vault opens. Whitefish, Montana — a flag, a tent, and Mexico on his mind. June 23, base camp. June 24, the Divide starts.

Day three, a storm rolls down the gravel line. A grizzly steps out at the bend. In Ovando, a sheep wagon called five-star fine — a wagon that had already met its end, though he only found that out days later, in Lincoln.

Feet up by a fire he built with his own hands. “Not a soul in sight. And I am loving it.” Then rain, pouring, for eight hours — eighty-something miles, still riding.

Lincoln. Lima. The Stockyard porch. The Tetons. Kevin Callahan waits on CO-9 with a sub, two sodas — and his house keys. Marshall Pass, 10,842 feet. The verdict from the road: I might just make it.

68 days. Five states. Santa Fe, New Mexico — August 30. The original song, “RIDE OR DIE THE DIVIDE,” written for this ride, sung over the whole film.

THAT WAS THEN. THIS IS NOW.

The lesson — THE DISCIPLINE: One day, one mile, one breath at a time — that’s how 68 days get ridden.

R.O.D.A. — Ride On, Divide Anyway.
